purpose: Construct one joint cohort supporting SBP and DBP associations with BMI plus residual SBP–DBP dependence. Both regressions use [1,(age-50)/10,female,(bmi-25)/5]. Generated rows have equal weights; report BMI coefficients in mmHg per 5 kg/m^2 and Pearson correlation of paired centered regression residuals. These are association projections, not intervention effects. No target value or desired direction is supplied.
row_weighting: equal weight, representing the declared weighted analytical population

analyses.estimator: Pearson correlation of paired centered residuals from the two above regressions on the same rows
